review.assessment: The change implements `RingBuffer<T>` using a pre-allocated backing `Vec` with separate metadata (`start`, `len`) to track logical position and count. It correctly handles circular overwriting by appending until full, then cyclically replacing elements at the `start` index while advancing it modulo capacity. `to_vec()` reconstructs the chronological order (oldest to newest) by walking indices from `start` with modular wrapping. The implementation satisfies all specified behaviors for any valid capacity and safely ignores operations on a zero-capacity buffer.
